invariants.statement: No external attempt occurs without an admitted exact intent.
A timeout, transport success, exit code or missing error is not a terminal effect observation.
An ambiguous outcome is observed/reconciled before retry unless the provider contract proves retry safety.

diagnostics.mechanism: validate intent -> attempt -> observation -> reconciliation ordering
determine whether fresh authoritative provider/system state exists
candidate semantic interpretation only when provider state cannot be decided mechanically

verification_oracles.condition: terminal outcomes require an attempt plus authoritative observation and reconciliation
post-action provider/system state is independently read and matches the reconciled result

ruin_boundaries.guard: When prior outcome is ambiguous, observe/reconcile before retry.
Exact current authority must bind to the exact action digest before intent.

MISSING_OBSERVATION.action: Return EVIDENCE_GAP and issue the provider-state observation operation.

AMBIGUOUS_OUTCOME.action: Do not retry; enter reconciliation or provider-specific adjudication.

UNRESOLVED.action: Preserve multiple effect hypotheses, acquire the cheapest authoritative discriminating observation, and forbid blind retry.

order: compile provider-specific reconciliation rule when validated

donors.mechanism: EFFECT contract: durable intent, idempotent attempt, observation and reconciliation
donors.claim_boundary: Local intent and attempt records do not prove remote effect outcome.

donors.mechanism: capability-gated connector execution, truth-source classification and signed receipts
donors.claim_boundary: FCP repository evidence establishes mechanism contracts, not live Rising Sea connector state.

donors.mechanism: write then independent read-back verification pattern
donors.claim_boundary: Session reconstruction is prior art for read-back verification, not an external-effect oracle itself.
